name: Kotoko Aihara
source:
Kotoko is a quiet and nerdy girl who feels very out of place at school. She and Youko have a very complicated relationship which she feels frustrated with. She loves manga and works part time at a manga café.

[from [url=https://honeysweetlies.carrd.co/#characters]official website[/url]]
